newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel restructuring seen from July.
newsitem.headline: Portucel restructuring seen from July.

text.p: Details of the planned restructuring of the Portuguese pulp and paper sector should be ready in July, an Economy Ministry official said on Thursday.

The official confirmed a report in the Diario Economico newspaper that a consortium made up of Salomon Brothers and Banco Chemical (Portugal) had been given the job of preparing the study for the reorganisation.
He said that the grouping to emerge from the reorganisation would be amongst the largest in the world in the sector.
The government, which is the major shareholder in pulp group Portucel Industrial, would reduce its holding in the sector.
It was possible that an international partner could be sought, the official added.
The state holds 50.4 percent of paper and pulp group Soporcel, via savings bank Caixa Geral de Depositos, and 55.72 percent of Portucel.
The revamping could also include Inapa and Caima Celulose, the official added.
The official said that the consortium would concentrate on the model of the restructuring, the timing, the necessary investments and their financing.
